svg.text: #605 Milestone: Enterprise Smart Manufacturing AI (L1 Edge Vision + L2 SCADA RAG + L3 cuOpt)
Cloud & AI Solution Architect Guide · 20 Factories (1,600 Lines) · 8.5ms Jetson YOLO QC + 0.8% VLM Escalation + PLC/SCADA Copilot
1. L1–L3 Edge-to-Cloud Smart Factory Hierarchy
L1 Assembly-Line Edge (<12ms Hard Real-Time · Zero WAN Dependency)
• YOLOv11 / RT-DETR TensorRT INT8 on Jetson Orin/Thor inspects 60fps cameras (8.5ms)
• Rejects 99.2% clear pass/fail locally; escalates ONLY 0.8% ambiguous defect crops!
L2 On-Site Factory Server Room (1× 2U Dual-L40S Server per Plant)
• Runs Qwen2.5-VL-32B on the 0.8% escalated defect crops (Root-cause process drift)
• Hosts Offline PLC/SCADA Fault-Code RAG Copilot + Chronos/TimesFM Vibration PdM
L3 Central Enterprise Cloud (4× H200 + NVIDIA cuOpt MILP Solver)
• Cross-plant spare-parts inventory optimization, supplier risk GraphRAG (#587)
• Distills weekly edge YOLOv11 weights from L2 VLM-labeled hard negatives
2. Bandwidth Math & 20-Factory Fleet Economics
✕ Why Streaming 1,600 Factory Cameras to Cloud VLM Is Impossible
• 1,600 lines × 60 fps × 1080p = 38.4 Gbps raw video uplink + 180ms WAN jitter
• High-speed actuator needs decision in <12ms before part moves 20cm down conveyor!
• L1 Edge INT8 YOLO (8.5ms) + 0.8% L2 VLM escalation cuts bandwidth by 99.2%
20-Factory Global Manufacturing AI ROI
• Unplanned Line Downtime Reduction: -64.0% (Chronos PdM + SCADA RAG Copilot)
• False Defect Scrap Escape Rate: 3.8% → 0.12% (L1 YOLO + L2 VLM active learning)
• L2+L3 Server Fleet across 20 Plants: 40× L40S (2/plant) + 4× Central H200 = $51.6k/mo
• Delivers $6.80M/year net manufacturing scrap & downtime savings!
